title: (Updated) Microsoft Teams: Updated recording and transcript access setting behavior for town halls and webinars
summary: Microsoft Teams is updating the "Who has access to the recording or transcript" option for Events App town halls and webinars. Starting mid-January 2027, access will depend on the RecordingForTownhall or RecordingForWebinar settings, not AllowCloudRecording. No action is required.
body:
Updated November 23, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and why]

We are updating how the Who has access to the recording or transcript option appears for Microsoft Teams Events scheduling through the Events App including town halls and webinars. Currently, when AllowCloudRecording is set to false, this option does not appear for these events. After this change, the option will appear only when the applicable RecordingForTownhall or RecordingForWebinar setting in CsTeamsEventsPolicy is enabled.

[Rollout schedule]

- General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): Beginning in mid-January 2027 (previously early-November 2026) and expected to complete by late January 2027 (previously mid-November 2026)[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Microsoft Teams organizers of Events created via the Events App including town halls and webinarsPlatforms and services

- Microsoft TeamsEvents created via the Events App including town halls and webinarsWhat will happen

The Who has access to the recording or transcript option will be based on the applicable RecordingForTownhall or RecordingForWebinar setting. It will no longer be based on the AllowCloudRecording setting.

[Action required and recommendations]

No action is required to enable this change.

We recommend updating your internal documentation to reflect this change.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
